title: Sequential Grant-Ready Combinational Loop
bug_signature: VCS-ERROR: Combinational loop: gnt → ready → gnt; simulation delta-cycle divergence
rtl:
always_ff @(posedge clk)
  if (ready) gnt <= next_gnt;  // ready is derived from gnt — loop
expected_root_cause: The always_ff block gates the grant update on the ready signal, but ready is itself combinationally derived from gnt; this creates a combinational feedback loop that causes simulation delta-cycle divergence and synthesis to generate unwanted latches.
description: A sequential path from `ready` back to the grant selection creates a combinational loop: ready depends on gnt, gnt depends on ready, causing simulation oscillation.
failure_log: VCS-ERROR: Combinational loop: gnt → ready → gnt; simulation delta-cycle divergence
success_log: Registered ready breaks loop. Simulation converges in one delta cycle.
